title: Review sized to the risk
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Judgment by independent assayers is replaced by review.
decision: Every pull request gets one review by someone who did not write it, on another model family than the builder where one is available. A story whose risk warrants it gets a second reviewer or the operator's review, as its story states. Two reviewers who disagree on meaning send the question to the architect.
consequences: The review and proportionality concepts state this.
